text:
Maria: heads-up — saw a regression on the 1F1B runs after yesterday's kernel selector tweak. end-to-end latency up ~12% on 16-GPU PP 8x2 microbatch setup. attaching profiler snapshot below
Ken: ugh, timeline looks like regular lull lines between all-reduce and forward starts. do you have the flamegraph?
Maria: pasted snippet from perf-bot. main suspicious pattern: repeated 1.2-2ms gaps at KV fetch boundary, not full stalls but they accumulate across pipeline stages.
perf-bot: SUMMARY: run=pp-16-8x2-mb2 kernel_selector=v2.3 prefetch_kv_stride=1 microbatch=2
perf-bot: timeline: [forward GPU0 start]----1.6ms gap----[allreduce]----0.9ms----[forward cont]----1.4ms gap----[allreduce]... total bubble overhead ~11%
Oliver: interesting. could be kernel selection picking a generic matmul kernel for the kv-projection at this sequence length. that kernel triggers a small async enqueue->sync pattern that shows up like a gap.
Sara: @Oliver can you repro locally with kernel logging turned on? maybe force the fused attention kernel and see if gaps disappear. also try increasing microbatch to 4 to amortize all-reduce cost.
Maria: repro steps I used:
```
export RL_RUNTIME_PROF=1
rlctl run --model redwood-xl-13b --pp 8 --tp 2 --microbatch 2 --trace=timeline.pb
```
The trace is attached (snippet above from perf-bot).
Ken: quick experiment idea: change prefetch_kv_stride from 1 to 2 so KV prefetch decouples slightly from the main forward. we had a similar fix for interleaved KV earlier.
Oliver: agreed, also try disabling allreduce fusion for small tensors — fusion is usually good but sometimes increases latency variance if it postpones starts. toggle: `ALLREDUCE_FUSION=false` in the runtime config.
Sara: I ran a short A/B: microbatch=2, stride=1 (baseline) vs microbatch=2, stride=2 (test) -> stride=2 dropped bubble overhead by ~5% but didn't eliminate; microbatch=4 + stride=2 got us back to baseline latency. so both knobs matter.
Maria: weird delta: kernel_selector=v2.3 -> v2.2 (fall back) removes those 1.6ms gaps entirely on same config. suggests a kernel match/regression in v2.3 for small GEMMs.
Ken: do we have unit tests that exercise small-K matmul kernel paths? if not, add a microbenchmark and hook into CI perf gate.
Oliver: I'll add a focused litmus: sequence_len=16, head_dim=64, kv-proj shape microbatch 2 -> run all kernels and compare enqueue/wait patterns. also capture cupti events.
perf-bot: action items logged: #1 reproduce+trace (Oliver) #2 add microkernel unit perf tests (Ken) #3 experiment with prefetch_kv_stride and MB tuning (Sara) #4 rollback candidate for kernel_selector v2.3 if regression confirmed (Maria)
Maria: also note: observed more noise when allreduce happens on host->device pinned streams. might be unrelated but worth a quick check on stream assignment.
Sara: i'll try changing allreduce stream to high-priority compute stream in next run.
Ken: ok plan: Oliver repro + kernel logs, Sara microbatch/stride sweep and stream triage, i'll draft test + perf gate. tag me on the PRs.
Maria: thanks — let's sync tomorrow after runs. :thumbsup:
